en.headline: 3 own commits, 4 issue actions, 1 discussion reply on openchamber
en.summary: On 2026-10-15, `sogeisetsu` recorded **3 own commits** across two repositories, plus 16 additional automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, the two own commits added a commit-attribution alias note to the agents docs and fixed the daily script so commit attribution supports aliases, including commits from non-GitHub account emails. In `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory`, a single chore commit tagged the `v1.15.5` release. No pull requests, reviews, or releases were recorded. On the issues side, 4 actions were logged in `openchamber/openchamber`: the user opened issue #4920 about the Context panel breakdown bar dividing whole-session estimates by the last message's input so `其他` is always 0%, commented on issue #4111 about deleting a multi-run leaving orphaned MCP child processes and `git worktree remove --force` failing with Permission denied, and both commented on and closed issue #4346 about `SidebarHeader.test.tsx` still passing after `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` were removed in `d9fbf6b`. The user also joined an existing discussion, #4821 `[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel` in `openchamber/openchamber`, which currently has 1 comment. No truncation was hit on any section.

zh.headline: 3 次本人提交、4 次 issue 操作、1 条讨论回复
zh.summary: 2026-10-15 当天，`sogeisetsu` 在两个仓库共完成 **3 次本人提交**，另有 16 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，两次本人提交分别为 agents 文档的口径段补充了提交归属别名说明，以及修复 daily 脚本使提交归属支持别名、兼容非 GitHub 账号邮箱的提交。在 `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 中，一次 chore 提交标记了 `v1.15.5` 版本。当天没有 PR、review 或 release 记录。Issue 方面共 4 次操作，全部发生在 `openchamber/openchamber`：用户新开了 #4920，反映 Context 面板 breakdown bar 用最后一条消息的 input 去除整段会话估算值，导致 `其他` 恒为 0%；在 #4111 上留言，讨论删除 multi-run 后遗留 MCP 子进程、`git worktree remove --force` 报 Permission denied 的问题；并对 #4346 进行了评论和关闭，该 issue 涉及 `d9fbf6b` 移除 `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` 后 `SidebarHeader.test.tsx` 仍然通过。此外，用户还参与了一条已有讨论，即 `openchamber/openchamber` 的 #4821 `[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel`，该讨论目前共 1 条评论。所有分节均未触发截断。
